description: Source code for the Visibility class in the GN build system, managing visibility patterns and access control for build items.

classes.name: Visibility
classes.description: Manages visibility patterns for build items, including setting, checking, and describing visibility rules.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets visibility patterns from a list value, verifying type and parsing each pattern.

methods.name: SetPrivate
methods.description: Sets visibility to private within a specific directory.

methods.name: CanSeeMe
methods.description: Checks if a given label is visible according to current patterns.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the visibility patterns, optionally formatted with brackets and indentation.

methods.name: AsValue
methods.description: Converts visibility patterns to a base::Value list for serialization.

methods.name: CheckItemVisibility
methods.description: Static method to verify if one item can see another based on visibility rules, setting error details if not.

methods.name: FillItemVisibility
methods.description: Static method to initialize an item's visibility from scope values, defaulting to public if unspecified.
